title: Procure five (5) Skurka AC Motors
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE LIFE CYCLE MANAGEMENT CENTER.COMMAND, CONTROL, COMMUNICATIONS & BATTLE MANAGEMENT.FA8307  AFLCMC HNCK C3IN
detail_text: Technical Applications Products (TAP) has a requirement to purchase items for the Advanced Airborne Research Equipment (AARE) suite, an airborne collection platform. These motors are used on the AARE suite in support of it's gas collection system. This is a Brand Name solicitation. The specific brand and part numbers are below: Item Noun Part Number Qty #1 Skurka Motor K1009-100 5
